brief.product: sonicdesk — a web workspace for bands ("version control for music"). This campaign promotes the Snippet feature: inside a song's mixer you select a 5–30 second part of the mix (presets 5/10/15/20/25/30 s or free drag), it snaps to section starts (Verse, Chorus, etc.), loops for listening, and exports as an audio file you can use to test the hook in Reels/TikTok before release.
brief.synthesis: Lifestyle scenes may be generated: musicians at home, rehearsal rooms, desks with instruments. Any motion or flat graphics. The product UI must not be AI-generated; use simplified mockups.
brief.immutables: sonicdesk logo and wordmark ("sonicdesk." with a lime dot), brand colours (lime #DFFF00 on near-black #060805), typefaces (Archivo for headlines, JetBrains Mono for body), the look of the product UI (square corners, thin hairline borders, pill-shaped waveforms), and the feature behaviour described in the claims.
